notes: From T4 to T13 the runner ran Server 1 into the already-seen IP Block two to four times a turn with no barrier breaker, paying 2 credits each time to clear the tag, until it fell to 0 credits; it never installed anything after Black Orchestra and T3 was four credit clicks while it sat on 10 credits.

A solid, fast scoring plan behind Tollbooth (GFI, Beale, Breaking News, GFI by T11), though the second GFI sat behind a single Tollbooth for three turns (T8-T11) against a runner with 30 credits, and the corp ran at 0-3 credits all game.
On T1 the runner used Mad Dash plus 3 credits to trash Regolith Mining License, taking meat damage, then played Dirty Laundry into unrezzed R&D ice holding only 2 cards and was flatlined by Anemone.

The corp left R&D unprotected T1-T3 while the runner camped it (T2 it spent a click drawing instead of icing R&D) and lost Private Security Force on T3, but otherwise scored cleanly, used Archer well and closed with Snare plus Scorched Earth on T7.

Good R&D pressure against an open R&D won the game, but the runner installed Liberated Account (6 credits) while carrying 4-6 tags on T5 and again on T8, and both copies were trashed; it also used Stimhack plus core damage on T6 just to trash Mumbad Virtual Tour.

On T5 the corp sat on 19 credits but did not rez the Server 1 ice and lost Hostile Takeover; R&D was open on T1 (two GFIs stolen); on T9 it played Consulting Visit into Audacity with nothing installed to advance, then lost GFI from an HQ guarded only by Data Raven.

Persistent R&D pressure and a well-timed Forged Activation Orders steal on T5 won it, but the runner facechecked HQ with an empty grip against a Snare deck (T2) and R&D with 2 cards (T3), and kept carrying Data Raven tags, which let the corp trash three Armitage Codebustings.

T1-T3 the runner made repeat R&D runs that only re-saw the same top card, and from T5 to T13 it clicked for credits every click up to 49 credits, never installing or running, while the corp slowly advanced and scored Accelerated Beta Test, Efficiency Committee and Accelerated Beta Test.

On T7 the corp put Project Vitruvius behind only Eli 1.0, which the installed 4-strength Atman visibly breaks, and lost it; from T13 to T27 it clicked for credits and discarded every turn up to 37 credits without installing or scoring, and finally lost Efficiency Committee from an HQ guarded by a single Heimdall.

After T13 the runner was completely passive, but for 20 turns the corp only piled ice on HQ, advanced ice, played Building Blocks with no effect and turned NGO Fronts into credits, scoring nothing and decking itself on T35 with 4 points; SSL Endorsement was lost on T7 behind a lone Surveyor.

The remote scoring plan with three Project Beales worked, but R&D was left unprotected until T7 while the runner ran it four times a turn, costing AR-Enhanced Security and GFI; on T2 the corp iced HQ instead, and on T4 it spent all clicks on credits.

Efficient play with Paperclip through Border Control and a Hippo-assisted dive through Orion on T8 for the second SSL Endorsement; the only oddity was using Stimhack with core damage for an Archives run on T4.

From T9 to T21 the corp spent two or three clicks and 2 credits each turn trying to trash DreamNet, which the runner kept using, leaving itself at 0 credits; it held Bellona in HQ behind one Enigma from T8 until it was stolen on T21, and it never scored.

For seven turns the runner made 3-4 R&D runs a turn that kept re-seeing the same top card, sitting on 1 credit and never playing a card or running HQ or the assets (Jeeves, Commercial Bankers Group), while the corp fast-advanced four agendas with Jeeves.

Good use of Film Critic, Hunting Grounds and Houdini through Tollbooth for GFI on T14 and Temujin Contract on R&D; the minor issues were lingering Hard-Hitting News tags that cost Daily Casts (T4-T5) and passive credit-clicking on T8 while holding 12-15 credits.

The corp never iced R&D (Hostile Takeover and Project Atlas stolen T5), and from T4 to T7 it only clicked for credits and discarded, building to 29 credits while holding Offworld Office and GFI instead of installing them; on T7 it left HQ naked after Hippo trashed Border Control.

R&D pressure through Turnpike and the late Data Leak Reversal plus Archives plan won, but the runner spent 9 credits on Femme Fatale for a Resistor on T2 and carried Turnpike tags for many turns, letting the corp trash Daily Casts and the DDoS installs.

Longevity Serum went into an unprotected Archives and was stolen on T4, and with the runner at 6 points the corp spent T4-T5 clicking for credits at 15-20 credits without adding any defence, then lost Send a Message from R&D.

On T1 the corp iced a remote before R&D and lost Beale and GFI immediately; the rest was slow but steady (AstroScript T3, GFI T12), with several passive credit/draw turns (T4-T6, T16) before an AstroScript-assisted Beale on T18.

The runner made repeat R&D runs that re-saw the same card on T1, then twice spent an entire turn and every credit removing all 4 Hard-Hitting News tags (T2, T7), so it could not contest Project Atlas (installed T7, scored T8); it never installed a breaker and later facechecked Archer on T11.
